##ptau217

```{r}
library(ggeffects)

fit_linear <- lmer(log(pTau217) ~ gest_age + age_v1 + education + ethnicity + (1|subject), data = data_biomarkers)
fit_poly2 <- lmer(log(pTau217) ~ poly(gest_age, 2) + age_v1 + education + ethnicity + (1|subject), data = data_biomarkers)
fit_poly3  <- lmer(log(pTau217) ~ poly(gest_age, 3) + age_v1 + education + ethnicity + (1|subject), data = data_biomarkers)

# Create prediction grid
new_data <- data.frame(
  gest_age  = seq(min(data_biomarkers$gest_age), max(data_biomarkers$gest_age), length.out = 200),
  age_v1    = mean(data_biomarkers$age_v1, na.rm = TRUE),
  education = names(sort(table(data_biomarkers$education), decreasing = TRUE))[1],
  ethnicity = names(sort(table(data_biomarkers$ethnicity), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
)

# Get predictions from each model
new_data$linear <- predict(fit_linear, newdata = new_data, re.form = NA)
new_data$poly2  <- predict(fit_poly2,  newdata = new_data, re.form = NA)
new_data$poly3  <- predict(fit_poly3,  newdata = new_data, re.form = NA)


new_data_long <- new_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(linear, poly2, poly3), names_to = "model", values_to = "predicted")

# Plot
ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = data_biomarkers, aes(x = gest_age, y = log(pTau217)), 
             alpha = 0.3, size = 1) +
  geom_line(data = new_data_long, aes(x = gest_age, y = predicted, 
             color = model, linetype = model), linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(linear = "steelblue", poly2 = "seagreen4", poly3 = "firebrick"),
                     labels = c("Linear","Quadratic polynomial", "Cubic polynomial")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(linear = "dashed", poly2 = "dotdash", poly3 = "solid"),
                        labels = c("Linear", "Quadratic polynomial", "Cubic polynomial")) +
  labs(x = "Gestational Age", y = "log(pTau217)", color = "Model", linetype = "Model") +
  theme_classic()

library(splines)

# First, identify the gest_age value corresponding to birth (timepoint 3)
birth_knot <- median(data_biomarkers$gest_age[data_biomarkers$Visit == 3], na.rm = TRUE)

fit_spline <- lmer(log(pTau217) ~ ns(gest_age, knots = birth_knot) +
                   age_v1 + education + ethnicity + (1|subject),
                   data = data_biomarkers)
summary(fit_spline)



new_data$predicted <- predict(fit_spline, newdata = new_data, re.form = NA)

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = data_biomarkers, aes(x = gest_age, y = log(pTau217)), 
             alpha = 0.3, size = 1) +
  geom_line(data = new_data, aes(x = gest_age, y = predicted), 
            color = "firebrick", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = birth_knot, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  annotate("text", x = birth_knot, y = Inf, label = "Birth", 
           vjust = 2, hjust = -0.1, color = "gray40") +
  labs(x = "Gestational Age", y = "log(pTau217)") +
  theme_classic()

library(mgcv)
fit_gam<-gamm(log(NFL) ~ s(gest_age, k=10) + age_v1 + education+ ethnicity,random = list(subject = ~1),data = data_biomarkers)
summary(fit_gam)
gam.check(fit_gam$gam)

new_data <- data.frame(
  gest_age  = seq(min(data_biomarkers$gest_age), max(data_biomarkers$gest_age), length.out = 200),
  age_v1    = mean(data_biomarkers$age_v1, na.rm = TRUE),
   education = names(sort(table(data_biomarkers$education), decreasing = TRUE))[1],
  ethnicity = names(sort(table(data_biomarkers$ethnicity), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
)

# predict.gam returns se.fit so you can add a confidence ribbon
pred <- predict(fit_gam$gam, newdata = new_data, se.fit = TRUE)

new_data$fit    <- pred$fit
new_data$upper  <- pred$fit + 1.96 * pred$se.fit
new_data$lower  <- pred$fit - 1.96 * pred$se.fit

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = data_biomarkers, aes(x = gest_age, y = log(NFL)),
             alpha = 0.3, size = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(data = new_data, aes(x = gest_age, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
              alpha = 0.2, fill = "firebrick") +
  geom_line(data = new_data, aes(x = gest_age, y = fit),
            color = "firebrick", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(x = "Gestational Age", y = "log(NFL)") +
  theme_classic()
```

# pTau217
```{r}
data_biomarkers_preg<-data_biomarkers%>%
  filter(Visit !=4)%>%
  mutate(scaled_gest_age = scale(gest_age))

fit_linear_pTau217 <- lmer(log(pTau217) ~ scaled_gest_age + age_v1 + education + ethnicity + (1|subject), data = data_biomarkers_preg)

fit_poly2_pTau217 <- lmer(log(pTau217) ~ poly(gest_age, 2, raw= T) + age_v1 + education + ethnicity + (1|subject), data = data_biomarkers_preg)
plot(fit_poly2_pTau217)

fit_poly3_pTau217  <- lmer(log(pTau217) ~ poly(gest_age, 3, raw= T) + age_v1 + education + ethnicity + (1|subject), data = data_biomarkers_preg)

summary(fit_linear_pTau217)
summary(fit_poly2_pTau217)
summary(fit_poly3_pTau217)
anova(fit_linear_pTau217, fit_poly2_pTau217, fit_poly3_pTau217)

# poly = 2 fits best

# Create prediction grid
new_data <- data.frame(
  gest_age  = seq(min(data_biomarkers_preg$gest_age), max(data_biomarkers_preg$gest_age), length.out = 200),
  age_v1    = mean(data_biomarkers_preg$age_v1, na.rm = TRUE),
  education = names(sort(table(data_biomarkers_preg$education), decreasing = TRUE))[1],
  ethnicity = names(sort(table(data_biomarkers_preg$ethnicity), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
)


new_data$linear_pTau217 <- predict(fit_linear_pTau217, newdata = new_data, re.form = NA)
new_data$poly2_pTau217  <- predict(fit_poly2_pTau217,  newdata = new_data, re.form = NA)
new_data$poly3_pTau217  <- predict(fit_poly3_pTau217,  newdata = new_data, re.form = NA)


new_data_long_pTau217 <- new_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(linear_pTau217, poly2_pTau217, poly3_pTau217), names_to = "model", values_to = "predicted")

# Plot
ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = data_biomarkers_preg, aes(x = gest_age, y = log(pTau217)), 
             alpha = 0.3, size = 1) +
  geom_line(data = new_data_long_pTau217, aes(x = gest_age, y = predicted, 
             color = model, linetype = model), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(data = data_biomarkers_preg, aes(x = gest_age, y = log(pTau217), group=subject), alpha=0.2)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c(linear_pTau217 = "steelblue", poly2_pTau217 = "seagreen4", poly3_pTau217 = "firebrick"),
                     labels = c("Linear","Quadratic polynomial", "Cubic polynomial")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(linear_pTau217 = "dashed", poly2_pTau217 = "dotdash", poly3_pTau217 = "solid"),
                        labels = c("Linear", "Quadratic polynomial", "Cubic polynomial")) +
  labs(x = "Gestational Age", y = "log(pTau217)", color = "Model", linetype = "Model") +
  theme_classic()


#########
# Now asking the question "does biomarker levels/trajectory during pregnancy predict later levels"
# problem is: cannot use random slopes in model because too complex, creates singlular fit (maybe I have not tried the correct optimizer)
# So now the options left are: doing the same but with the random intercepts, or doing the same with slope between v1-v3. both mean losing some information

slopes <- tibble(slope_pTau217 = coef(fit_poly2_pTau217)$subject["poly(gest_age, 2, raw = T)2"])


data_biomarkers_v4<-data_biomarkers[data_biomarkers$Visit==4,]

time_v3_v4<-data_biomarkers%>%
  dplyr::select(subject, Visit, gest_age)%>%
  filter(Visit==3|Visit ==4)%>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Visit, values_from = gest_age)%>%
  mutate(time_diff_v3_v4 = `4`-`3`)%>%
  dplyr::select(-`3`, -`4`)

test<-coef(fit_poly2_pTau217)

# Join with V4 outcome
analysis_data <- slopes %>%
  left_join(data_biomarkers_v4, by = "subject")%>%
  left_join(., time_v3_v4)

m1 <- lm(log(pTau217) ~ slope_pTau217+ time_diff_v3_v4+age_v1 + education + ethnicity , data = analysis_data)
#but need to include time between V3 and V4 + covariates

summary(m1)

plot(log(analysis_data$pTau217), analysis_data$slope_pTau217)
```

## SOlution 1: predict()
fit non linear models with all 4 visits, use 60% for training and 40% for test.

```{r}
fit_pTau217 <- lmer(log(pTau217) ~ gest_age + age_v1 + education + ethnicity + (1|subject), data = data_biomarkers)

fit_poly2_pTau217 <- lmer(log(pTau217) ~ poly(gest_age, 2, raw= T) + age_v1 + education + ethnicity + (1|subject), data = data_biomarkers)

fit_poly3_pTau217 <- lmer(log(pTau217) ~ poly(gest_age, 3, raw= T) + age_v1 + education + ethnicity + (1|subject), data = data_biomarkers)
summary(fit_poly3_pTau217)

anova(fit_pTau217, fit_poly2_pTau217, fit_poly3_pTau217)

set.seed(123)  # for reproducibility

n <- nrow(data_biomarkers)
subjects <- unique(data_biomarkers$subject)
train_subjects <- sample(subjects, size = 0.6 * length(subjects))

data_biomarkers<-data_biomarkers%>%
  mutate(log_ptau217 = log(pTau217))%>%
  filter(!is.na(log_ptau217))
train_data <- data_biomarkers[data_biomarkers$subject %in% train_subjects, ]
test_data  <- data_biomarkers[!data_biomarkers$subject %in% train_subjects, ]

model <- lmer(log_ptau217 ~ poly(gest_age, 3, raw= T) + age_v1 + education + ethnicity + (1|subject), data = train_data)
predictions <- stats::predict(model, newdata = test_data, allow.new.levels = TRUE)

actuals <- test_data$log_ptau217

# RMSE
rmse <- sqrt(mean((actuals - predictions)^2))

# MAE
mae <- mean(abs(actuals - predictions))

# R-squared
ss_res <- sum((actuals - predictions)^2)
ss_tot <- sum((actuals - mean(actuals))^2)
r2 <- 1 - ss_res / ss_tot

cat("RMSE:", rmse, "\nMAE:", mae, "\nR²:", r2, "\n")

summary(model)
```

## Solution 2: AUC

```{r}
pregnancy_summary <- data_biomarkers %>%
  filter(Visit %in% c(1,2,3)) %>%
  arrange(subject, gest_age) %>%
  group_by(subject) %>%
  summarise(
    auc = sum(diff(gest_age) * (head(log_ptau217, -1) + tail(log_ptau217, -1)) / 2)
  )

visit4_data <- data_biomarkers[data_biomarkers$Visit == 4, c("subject", "log_ptau217")]

modelling_data <- merge(pregnancy_summary, visit4_data, by = "subject")%>%
  left_join(., data)

model <- lm(log_ptau217 ~ auc + age_v1 + education + ethnicity, data = modelling_data)
summary(model)
```



# NFL
```{r}

fit_linear_NFL <- lmer(log(NFL) ~ gest_age + age_v1 + education + ethnicity + (1|subject), data = data_biomarkers_preg)
fit_poly2_NFL <- lmer(log(NFL) ~ poly(gest_age, 2) + age_v1 + education + ethnicity + (1|subject), data = data_biomarkers_preg)
fit_poly3_NFL  <- lmer(log(NFL) ~ poly(gest_age, 3) + age_v1 + education + ethnicity + (1|subject), data = data_biomarkers_preg)

summary(fit_linear_NFL)
summary(fit_poly2_NFL)
summary(fit_poly3_NFL)
anova(fit_linear_NFL, fit_poly2_NFL, fit_poly3_NFL)


new_data$linear_NFL <- predict(fit_linear_NFL, newdata = new_data, re.form = NA)
new_data$poly2_NFL  <- predict(fit_poly2_NFL,  newdata = new_data, re.form = NA)
new_data$poly3_NFL  <- predict(fit_poly3_NFL,  newdata = new_data, re.form = NA)


new_data_long <- new_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with(c("linear", "poly2", "poly3")), names_to = "model", values_to = "predicted")

# Plot
ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = data_biomarkers_preg, aes(x = gest_age, y = log(NFL)), 
             alpha = 0.3, size = 1) +
  geom_line(data = new_data_long, aes(x = gest_age, y = predicted, 
             color = model, linetype = model), linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(linear_NFL = "steelblue", poly2_NFL = "seagreen4", poly3_NFL = "firebrick"),
                     labels = c("Linear","Quadratic polynomial", "Cubic polynomial")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(linear_NFL = "dashed", poly2_NFL = "dotdash", poly3_NFL = "solid"),
                        labels = c("Linear", "Quadratic polynomial", "Cubic polynomial")) +
  labs(x = "Gestational Age", y = "log(NFL)", color = "Model", linetype = "Model") +
  theme_classic()

fe <- fixef(fit_poly3_NFL)
re <- lme4::ranef(fit_poly3_NFL)$subject

blups_NFL <- re %>%
  as_tibble(rownames = "subject") %>%
  mutate(subject = as.integer(subject))%>%
  rename(
    re = `(Intercept)`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    slope_NFL = fe["(Intercept)"]+ re,
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(subject, slope_NFL)

# Join with V4 outcome
analysis_data <- blups_NFL %>%
  left_join(data_biomarkers_v4, by = "subject")%>%
  left_join(., time_v3_v4)

m2 <- lm(log(NFL) ~ slope_NFL+ time_diff_v3_v4+age_v1 + education + ethnicity, data = analysis_data)

summary(m2)

plot(log(analysis_data$NFL), analysis_data$slope_NFL)
```

```{r}
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with(c("linear", "poly2", "poly3")), names_to = "model", values_to = "predicted")

# Plot
ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = data_biomarkers_preg, aes(x = gest_age, y = log(GFAP)), 
             alpha = 0.3, size = 1) +
  geom_line(data = new_data_long, aes(x = gest_age, y = predicted, 
             color = model, linetype = model), linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(linear_GFAP = "steelblue", poly2_GFAP = "seagreen4", poly3_GFAP = "firebrick"),
                     labels = c("Linear","Quadratic polynomial", "Cubic polynomial")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(linear_GFAP = "dashed", poly2_GFAP = "dotdash", poly3_GFAP = "solid"),
                        labels = c("Linear", "Quadratic polynomial", "Cubic polynomial")) +
  labs(x = "Gestational Age", y = "log(GFAP)", color = "Model", linetype = "Model") +
  theme_classic()

fe <- fixef(fit_poly2_GFAP)
re <- lme4::ranef(fit_poly2_GFAP)$subject

blups_GFAP <- re %>%
  as_tibble(rownames = "subject") %>%
  mutate(subject = as.integer(subject))%>%
  rename(
    re = `(Intercept)`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    slope_GFAP = fe["(Intercept)"]+ re,
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(subject, slope_GFAP)

# Join with V4 outcome
analysis_data <- blups_GFAP %>%
  left_join(data_biomarkers_v4, by = "subject")%>%
  left_join(., time_v3_v4)

m3 <- lm(log(GFAP) ~ slope_GFAP+ time_diff_v3_v4+age_v1 + education + ethnicity, data = analysis_data)

summary(m3)

plot(log(analysis_data$GFAP), analysis_data$slope_GFAP)
```

##ptau217
```{r}
data_clean_preg<-data_clean%>%
  filter(Visit !="v4")%>%
  mutate(scaled_GA_weeks = scale(GA_weeks))

fit_linear_pTau217_clean <- lmer(log(pTau217) ~ GA_weeks + age_12w_m + hosp_recruit_m_12w+ time_storage_ptau217+ (1|id_bisc), data = data_clean_preg)

fit_poly2_pTau217_clean <- lmer(log(pTau217) ~ poly(GA_weeks, 2, raw= T) + age_12w_m + hosp_recruit_m_12w  +time_storage_ptau217+ (1|id_bisc), data = data_clean_preg)

fit_poly3_pTau217_clean  <- lmer(log(pTau217) ~ poly(GA_weeks, 3, raw= T) + age_12w_m + hosp_recruit_m_12w +time_storage_ptau217+ (1|id_bisc), data = data_clean_preg)

summary(fit_linear_pTau217_clean)
summary(fit_poly2_pTau217_clean)
summary(fit_poly3_pTau217_clean)
anova_ptau217<-anova(fit_linear_pTau217_clean, fit_poly2_pTau217_clean, fit_poly3_pTau217_clean)


# poly = 2 fits best

# Create prediction grid
new_data <- data.frame(
  GA_weeks  = seq(min(data_clean_preg$GA_weeks, na.rm = TRUE), 
                   max(data_clean_preg$GA_weeks, na.rm = TRUE), 
                   length.out = 200),
  age_12w_m    = mean(data_clean_preg$age_12w_m, na.rm = TRUE),
  hosp_recruit_m_12w = names(sort(table(data_clean_preg$hosp_recruit_m_12w), decreasing = TRUE))[1],
  time_storage_ptau217  = seq(min(data_clean_preg$time_storage_ptau217, na.rm = TRUE), 
                               max(data_clean_preg$time_storage_ptau217, na.rm = TRUE), 
                               length.out = 200)
)


new_data$linear_pTau217 <- predict(fit_linear_pTau217_clean, newdata = new_data, re.form = NA)
new_data$poly2_pTau217  <- predict(fit_poly2_pTau217_clean,  newdata = new_data, re.form = NA)
new_data$poly3_pTau217  <- predict(fit_poly3_pTau217_clean,  newdata = new_data, re.form = NA)


new_data_long_pTau217 <- new_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(linear_pTau217, poly2_pTau217, poly3_pTau217), names_to = "model", values_to = "predicted")

# Plot
p1<-ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = data_clean_preg, aes(x = GA_weeks, y = log(pTau217)), 
             alpha = 0.2, size = 1) +
  geom_line(data = new_data_long_pTau217[new_data_long_pTau217$model=="poly2_pTau217",], aes(x = GA_weeks, y = predicted, 
             color = model, linetype = model), linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_line(data = data_clean_preg, aes(x = GA_weeks, y = log(pTau217), group=id_bisc), alpha=0.1)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c(poly2_pTau217 = "deepskyblue1"),
                     labels = c("Quadratic polynomial")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(poly2_pTau217 = "solid"),
                        labels = c("Quadratic polynomial")) +
  labs(x = "Gestational Age (weeks)", y = "log(pTau217)", color = "Model", linetype = "Model") +
  theme_classic()
```

## Tables

```{r}

# tidy() extracts F, df, p, etc. from an aov object
tbl1 <- tidy(anova_ptau217) %>% mutate(model = "pTau217")
tbl2 <- tidy(anova_NFL) %>% mutate(model = "NfL")
tbl3 <- tidy(anova_GFAP) %>% mutate(model = "GFAP")

combined_data <- bind_rows(tbl1, tbl2, tbl3)%>%
  dplyr::select(model, term, df, AIC, BIC, p.value) %>%
  rename(p = p.value)%>%
  mutate(term=case_when(term == "fit_linear_pTau217_clean" ~ "Linear",
                        term == "fit_linear_NFL_clean" ~ "Linear",
                        term == "fit_linear_GFAP_clean" ~ "Linear",
                        term == "fit_poly2_pTau217_clean" ~ "Quadratic",
                        term == "fit_poly2_NFL_clean" ~ "Quadratic",
                        term == "fit_poly2_GFAP_clean" ~ "Quadratic",
                        term == "fit_poly3_pTau217_clean" ~ "Cubic",
                        term == "fit_poly3_NFL_clean" ~ "Cubic",
                        term == "fit_poly3_GFAP_clean" ~ "Cubic",
                   .default = as.character(term)))

table_anova<-gt(combined_data)%>%
  fmt_number(columns=c(p, AIC, BIC), decimals = 3)

gtsave(table_anova, file = "anova_table.docx")
```


```{r}
table_ptau217<-tbl_regression(fit_poly2_pTau217_clean,
               tidy_fun = broom.mixed::tidy,
               label=list(GA_weeks= "Gestation time (weeks)",
                          age_12w_m = "Age at first visit",
                          hosp_recruit_m_12w = "Hospital of recruitment",
                          time_storage_ptau217 = "Time to storage"),
               estimate_fun = ~ style_number(.x, digits = 4),
               include = c(GA_weeks, age_12w_m, hosp_recruit_m_12w, time_storage_ptau217))%>%
  modify_table_body(
    ~ .x %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        label = dplyr::case_when(
          label == "poly(GA_weeks, 2, raw = T)1"  ~ "Linear term",
          label == "poly(GA_weeks, 2, raw = T)2"  ~ "Quadratic term",
          TRUE ~ label
        )
      )
  ) %>%
  modify_table_body(
  ~ .x %>%
    dplyr::group_by(variable) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      label = dplyr::if_else(
        variable == "hosp_recruit_m_12w" & row_type == "level",
        as.character(cumsum(variable == "hosp_recruit_m_12w" & row_type == "level")),
        label
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
)%>%
  modify_column_unhide(columns = std.error) %>%
  modify_header(estimate ~ "**Estimate**", label ~ "**Variables, N = {N}**")
```
